name: wide_fm_tone
description: Warbird-like dive pass, 4th harmonic dominant (812 Hz source -> ~1245/605 Hz); RPM jitter 0.4% std at ~4 Hz rate, so h4 is ~7 Hz wide with a skirt. Steepest ~170 Hz/s.

name: wide_fm_airshow
description: Same physics, faster/closer (190 Hz base, h4 ~760 Hz source), 0.5% jitter, under an airshow announcer (continuous speech) and gusty wind.

name: twin_props_a
description: Twin-engine prop: two 3-blade families at 88 and 92.5 Hz (constant 4.5 Hz source offset), h1-6 each, shaft-rate sidebands (h*f0 +- f0/3) at -14 dB.

name: twin_props_b
description: Twin turboprop, 4-blade families at 102 and 108 Hz (6 Hz offset), sidebands -12 dB, lower pass with a ground reflection (R=0.5).

name: dense_fan_a
description: Crop-duster-like close low pass (60 m slant): f0 95 Hz, 20 lumpy harmonics to 1.9 kHz source; h20 sweeps ~450 Hz/s at CPA.

name: dense_fan_b
description: f0 82 Hz, 18 harmonics, 92 m slant, ground reflection (R=0.6) fades the tones.

name: jet_a
description: Jet flyover (292 m slant, 110 m/s): fan tone 1180 Hz plus compressor tones 1720/2350 Hz (0.3% N1 drift, in the truth) under a strong broadband roar, louder aft; ground reflection (R=0.8, mic 1.7 m) gives a moving Lloyd's-mirror comb. Truth = tones only.

name: jet_b
description: Low fast jet (117 m slant, 150 m/s): tones 1450/1950/2300 Hz source, roar 20 dB over the tones, R=0.9, mic 1.5 m.

name: maneuver_parabola
description: Curved track of the paper's eq. 42 shape, p(u) = (80u, 150 + 0.55u^2, 250) m: speed 80 -> 115 m/s, heading turns ~100 deg. Prop f0 105 Hz, 4 harmonics.

name: maneuver_turn
description: Constant-speed circling (r 700 m, 65 m/s, 68 s per orbit, nearest ~280 m) with a +3% throttle step at 70 s: approach/recede/approach, no straight template fits.

name: speech_prop
description: Prop pass (115 Hz, 4 harmonics, 400 m) under continuous two-talker speech whose voice harmonics cover the same band.

name: wind_traffic_prop
description: Prop pass (72 Hz, 5 harmonics, 500 m) with heavy gusty mic wind and distant road traffic (broadband 30-600 Hz roar + idle lines at 27/41 Hz).

name: faint_long_a
description: Distant high pass (1.6 km slant): f0 98 Hz, 3 harmonics, level set so the attacker's integrated z is ~5.

name: faint_long_b
description: Very distant pass (2.2 km), f0 130 Hz, 2 harmonics, with light speech; attacker z ~4.

name: null_music
description: Tonal music: chords, bass, melody with vibrato and glides, kick. No aircraft.

name: null_birds
description: Birdsong: FM sweeps (some down to 900 Hz), trills, a 450 Hz dove coo. No aircraft.

name: null_traffic
description: Distant road-traffic roar with idle engine lines, light wind. No aircraft.

name: null_generator
description: Stationary generator, 1800 rpm (30 Hz shaft) harmonics to 1.5 kHz with 0.8% governor drift (h45 wanders ~+-11 Hz), 50 Hz alternator lines. No aircraft.

name: null_ambience
description: Outdoor ambience only (pink floor + light wind). No aircraft.
